name: Brigadier General Gulzar Uddin Ahmed
role: Deputy Director General of Bangladesh Rifles (BDR)
contribution: He served as a senior seconded army officer in Bangladesh Rifles and held the post of Deputy Director General.
context: He was among the senior officers killed during the 2009 Pilkhana killings at BDR headquarters in Dhaka.
impact: His death is widely treated as part of the upper-command losses that reflected the institutional shock to Bangladesh's security establishment after the 2009 event.
highlight: A senior BDR command officer whose death became emblematic of the 2009 Pilkhana command-level losses.
seoTitle: Gulzar Uddin Ahmed: BDR Officer Killed in the 2009 Pilkhana Massacre
seoDescription: Learn about Brigadier General Gulzar Uddin Ahmed, his BDR command role, and the institutional impact of his death during the 2009 Pilkhana killings.
shortAnswer: Gulzar Uddin Ahmed was a senior BDR officer killed during the 2009 Pilkhana killings at the BDR headquarters in Dhaka.
